cards.question: Вы легко и с удовольствием беретесь за длительную умственную или физическую работу?
cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE standalone illustration asset for a Russian psychological test app. The reference image defines ONLY the sophisticated handmade matte modelling-clay material, adult character style, warm ivory / olive sage / ochre / terracotta palette, subtle fingerprint and pressed leaf details, and soft warm upper-left lighting. Deliver a landscape 3:2 composition, approximately 1536x1024, on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background. Only the physical sculpted objects are visible. No backdrop, floor, ground slab, ambient haze, glow, vignette, full-canvas color, text, letters, numbers, watermark, UI, card, frame or big empty text area. Keep all silhouettes fully inside frame with even 7% transparent safety margin. Transparent gaps between objects, clean antialiased edges. Aim for a few large readable forms, clear scene meaningful at 320px wide. Refined friendly adult clay figure(s), simple faces and realistic adult proportions, not babyish. Small oak leaves and acorn as understated category motif. No checks, scores, trophies or suggestion of a correct answer. This image will sit BELOW the question, which is separate HTML and must NOT appear inside the asset.
Scene meaning: willingness to engage in prolonged mental or physical work. A single adult with wavy dark brown clay hair, sage sweater and terracotta trousers is seated at a compact warm ivory worktable, calmly and attentively assembling a substantial geometric wooden-clay model from several ochre blocks. Their hands are actively at work. On the tabletop, a small blank open notebook with no symbols, a few clay blocks and a short orderly stack of two books convey sustained thoughtful work. Composition compact triangle: adult at left-center, model rising at right, table legs and chair visible, no broad floor shadow. A small oak sprig with two leaves and one acorn sits naturally by a table foot. The figure's body language is absorbed and relaxed. No clock or hourglass: focus on engaging in substantial work.
